articles.title: Baby and man dead in Russia after Ukraine drone strikes
articles.summary: A six-month-old baby tragically died in Russia's Moscow region after debris from a drone fell on a building, Governor Andrei Vorobyov confirmed. This incident highlights the devastating impact of ongoing conflicts on civilian populations, including non-combatants in urban areas. The event underscores the evolving threats posed by modern warfare and the severe human cost associated with such cross-border incidents.

articles.title: Transatlantic Fiber-Optic Expialidocious
articles.summary: Despite terms like 'cloud' and 'WiFi' suggesting a wireless internet, nearly all global online data transmission relies on a vast physical infrastructure, primarily undersea and land-based cables. This crucial network forms the backbone of our digital world, moving information across continents rather than through the air. Aspirants should note the foundational wired nature underlying perceived wireless convenience.
